z-m-31-13.title: Which determinant rule we suppose trust?
z-m-31-13.topic: Guessing and testing determinant for product det(AB) and for sum det(A+B)
z-m-31-13.goal: Learn that 1 or 2 examples no enough to separate rules, use counterexamples and algebra to find where rule hold, and make coincidental examples yourself.
z-m-31-13.material: For 2×2 matrices A and B, 2 possible rules dey. (R1) det(AB) = det(A)·det(B), (R2) det(A+B) = det(A) + det(B). Here det mean determinant. We wan know which rule always true.
